title: Bank transfers
tagline: Negative transfers steal money, the wrong account is checked, and money disappears into accounts that don't exist.
lookFor: Money: the amount must be a number above 0. `!amount` lets negative numbers through.
Check the user owns the account the money LEAVES.
Check everything (both accounts, enough money, owner) BEFORE changing anything.
Edge cases: sending to yourself, 0, text instead of a number.

bugs.symptom: A negative amount moves money backwards
bugs.cause: `!amount` only blocks 0. A negative amount moves money backwards.

bugs.symptom: Users can transfer from someone else's account
hints: Which account does the owner check look at?
bugs.cause: It checks who owns `to`, not `from`. Anyone can take money from any account.

bugs.symptom: Transfer to an unknown account loses the money
hints: When is `to` looked up: before or after the money is taken?
bugs.cause: Money is taken first. Then `to` turns out not to exist, but the money is already gone.
bugs.fix: Load and check both accounts first, then move the money.

hints: What if from and to are the same?
bugs.cause: Nothing stops sending money to the same account.
bugs.fix: `if (fromId === toId) throw new HttpError(400, 'cannot transfer to the same account')`
